dedupe_keys.name: uganda water and environment management information system wemis water supply sanitation rural water and water for production databases

description: WEMIS is the Ministry of Water and Environment's portal for its management information systems in Uganda. Its landing page, read on 27 September 2026, lists the Water Supply Management Information System (WASMIS) with a breakdown of water sources (deep boreholes 52.8 percent, shallow wells 19.9 percent, protected springs 17.5 percent, public taps 9.5 percent, rainwater harvesting tanks 0.3 percent), the Sanitation Management Information System (SANMIS), the Rural Water and Sanitation database (RUWAS) used to plan and report the district water and sanitation conditional grant, the Water for Production Management Information System (WFPMIS) with assets such as boreholes, valley tanks, earth dams and irrigation, a project management system, and environment and forestry databases. Coverage is Uganda. Access is online; the landing page shows summaries and offers login and registration for the applications. Caveats: which data are public without an account was not tested, and no licence is stated. Simulation uses: water source and asset inventories for rural and urban supply planning. Related records: WPdx (data-wpdx-water-point-data-exchange) and SIASAR (data-siasar-rural-water-sanitation-information-system).
